# Fixtures

Generated by `npm run fixtures`, committed on purpose: the tests read these folders from
disk, so a fixture proves the message a human would actually see — not just that a code
fired (CONTENT-CONTRACT.md §12).

Each broken fixture is one of the two valid subjects with exactly one defect applied.

| Fixture | Code | Base | Defect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `E001-missing-manifest-key` | E001 | valid-subject | `summary` is missing from manifest.yml |
| `E002-slug-mismatch` | E002 | valid-subject | manifest.slug disagrees with the folder name |
| `E003-missing-part-file` | E003 | valid-split | 1_understand_part2.md was never saved |
| `E004-parts-gap` | E004 | valid-split | the parts ranges leave T3 uncovered |
| `E005-missing-outline` | E005 | valid-subject | the outline comment is gone |
| `E006-unsafe-topic-name` | E006 | valid-subject | an outline topic name contains parentheses |
| `E007-out-of-outline-order` | E007 | valid-subject | Level 1 emits T2 before T1 |
| `E008-heading-drift` | E008 | valid-subject | Level 2 renamed a heading the other levels still use |
| `E009-topic-absent-from-level-0` | E009 | valid-subject | Level 3 carries a topic Level 0 never named |
| `E010-duplicate-topic-id` | E010 | valid-subject | the outline declares T2 twice |
| `E011-stray-h2` | E011 | valid-subject | Level 1 has an H2 that is neither a topic nor the ToC |
| `E012-toc-mismatch` | E012 | valid-subject | the in-file ToC names a topic differently from the outline |
| `E013-nav-anchor-drift` | E013 | valid-subject | a nav strip anchor does not match its own heading |
| `E014-unknown-t-reference` | E014 | valid-subject | prose references T7, which is not in the outline |
| `E015-broken-wikilink` | E015 | valid-subject | a wikilink points at a subject that does not exist |
| `E015-broken-prereq` | E015 | valid-subject | a prereqs entry points at a subject that does not exist |
| `E016-topic-count-mismatch` | E016 | valid-subject | topic_count disagrees with the parsed outline |
| `E017-frontmatter-in-level-file` | E017 | valid-subject | frontmatter was added to a level file |
| `E018-over-nested-topic` | E018 | valid-subject | the outline nests two levels deep |
| `W-warnings-only` | W001 | valid-subject | warnings only: unknown manifest key, missing L2 subsection, unknown L2 H3, untagged fence, unparseable mermaid, topic missing from L1 |
